input: Existing validated HMA first_three_tables/evolutions.txt export; no ROM extraction or new parser.
canonicalFormat: UTF-8 source,target,method,param,aux,physicalSlot,uppercase8DigitRomAddress; LF between records, no final LF; source then physical slot order.
implementation: Version-bound compact read-only table carries raw values, physical slot and record address.
Shared branch conditions/evidence replace individually written sample descriptions.
254 final reverse write is calculated for every source from initial-table physical order, without a species-1081 special algorithm.
Forward ReverseTarget is a target-table result, never assumed to equal source; ambiguous multi-record lookup remains null.
Existing resource Kind/Options remain intact when independent transitions are attached; tooltip displays both categories.
No Pokemon setter, package schema or ROM reader changed; metadata does not execute a conversion or permit permanent Form editing.

validation.coverage: Fixed independent 233-record snapshot and canonical digest, method/aux counts, 16 historical examples, aux2 move condition, all reverse final writes, 21 mismatches, unresolved IDs, immutable metadata, unchanged PKM bytes, existing resource categories and eight synthetic WithTransitions overlap cases.

limits: Only the requested xunit class and WinForms host build ran. Linked tooltip source is tested, not GUI interaction. Specific unmapped outer gates and later handler/backup persistence boundaries remain documented. This covers all 253/254 records of V1_1, not all possible Mercury form mechanisms.
